meta.title: Manage your booking
meta.description: Reschedule or cancel your Marg Darshan consultation.

title: Reschedule or cancel

policy.ok: You can reschedule for free or cancel with a full refund up to 24 hours before your session.
policy.too_late: Your session is less than 24 hours away, so it can no longer be changed online. Please message us on WhatsApp and we'll do our best to help.
policy.past: This session time has already passed. For any help, please reach us on WhatsApp.
policy.cancelled: This booking has already been cancelled.
policy.not_manageable: This booking can't be changed online right now. Please contact us on WhatsApp.

reschedule.title: Pick a new time
reschedule.error: We couldn't load available times. Please try again.
reschedule.none: No times available on this day.
reschedule.istNote: All times are in Indian Standard Time (IST).

cancelModal.title: Cancel this booking?
cancelModal.body: Your session on {when} will be cancelled and the slot released.
cancelModal.refund: The full amount you paid will be refunded to your original payment method within 5–7 working days.
cancelModal.noRefund: This cancellation is not eligible for a refund.

rescheduled.title: Your new time is confirmed
rescheduled.body: Your session is now on {when}. We've emailed you the updated details.

cancelled.title: Your booking has been cancelled
cancelled.refund: A refund of {amount} has been initiated and should reach you in 5–7 working days.
cancelled.refundPending: Your refund will be processed manually by our team — no action is needed from you.

errors.slot_unavailable: Sorry, that time was just taken. Please pick another one.
errors.slot_invalid: That time can't be booked. Please pick another one.
errors.not_allowed: This booking can no longer be changed online. Please contact us on WhatsApp.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.conflict_retry: Your booking changed in the meantime. Please refresh the page and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again or contact us on WhatsApp.

whatsappMessage: Hello, I need help rescheduling or cancelling my Marg Darshan booking.

invalid.title: This link isn't valid
invalid.body: The link may have expired or been copied incorrectly. Please use the link from your latest booking email, or message us on WhatsApp.

unavailable.title: Booking management is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.body: Please try again in a little while, or message us on WhatsApp and we'll help right away.
